user.title: Connect to FurryTail
user.description: Paste the access token from the FurryTail app: open Dev Tools, inspect any request, and copy the Authorization header value. The app's token is valid for 30 days. The MAC address is optional.

data_description.mac: Optional MAC address of the litter box, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Use it to select one of multiple paired devices.
data_description.place_id: Optional place (home) ID from the FurryTail app. Needed for device control; leave empty to auto-detect.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate FurryTail
reauth_confirm.description: Paste a fresh access token from the FurryTail app: open Dev Tools, inspect any request, and copy the Authorization header value. The app's token is valid for 30 days. The MAC address is optional.

data_description.mac: Optional MAC address of the litter box, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
data_description.place_id: Optional place (home) ID from the FurryTail app. Needed for device control; leave empty to auto-detect.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to FurryTail. Check the connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid or expired. Paste a fresh token from the FurryTail app.
error.already_configured: This FurryTail account is already configured.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a valid MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_configured: This FurryTail account is already configured.

init.title: FurryTail options
init.description: Choose how often FurryTail is polled when live MQTT updates are unavailable.

data_description.scan_interval: Polling interval in seconds, from 10 to 300.
data_description.place_id: Place (home) ID from the FurryTail app. Required for device control.
